import { Button } from "@/registry/seam/ui/button"
import {
  Drawer,
  DrawerContent,
  DrawerDescription,
  DrawerFooter,
  DrawerHeader,
  DrawerTitle,
  DrawerTrigger,
  DrawerClose,
} from "@/registry/seam/ui/drawer"

export default function DrawerDemo() {
  return (
    <Drawer>
      <DrawerTrigger render={<Button variant="outline">Open drawer</Button>} />
      <DrawerContent>
        <DrawerHeader>
          <DrawerTitle>Mobile sheet</DrawerTitle>
          <DrawerDescription>
            Drag the handle down to dismiss — Base UI's native swipe
            physics, backdrop dimming as you go.
          </DrawerDescription>
        </DrawerHeader>
        <DrawerFooter>
          <DrawerClose render={<Button>Done</Button>} />
        </DrawerFooter>
      </DrawerContent>
    </Drawer>
  )
}
